column7: All-analog dual pedal combining a Colorsound Power Boost / Overdriver-inspired section with Hiwatt-style 100W DR103 and 50W DR504 voicings; independent footswitches, passive series effects loop, PWR/ODR and 103/504 voicing switches, top-mounted jacks and relay true bypass.

column7: Octave fuzz unveiled at NAMM 2023; controls include Sensitivity, Dry Level, Fuzz Level, HP filter, two LP filters, three-way mids, Edge, Bias/voltage starve and transformer polarity; designed for upper-octave texture with a subtle lower harmonic.

column10: The V2 status is builder-stated. Exact V2 introduction date remains unresolved; do not use the 2023 roundup date as a manufactured launch date.
